name: cellxgene_census
description: CELLxGENE Census is a versioned public single-cell and spatial transcriptomics dataset primitive. Use it when querying atlas-scale metadata, expression slices, embeddings, summary counts, or source H5AD URIs before handing results to AnnData, Scanpy, or scvi-tools workflows.
capabilities: Query versioned public Census releases by organism, tissue, disease, cell type, assay, and gene.
Return AnnData slices or metadata tables without downloading whole datasets first.
Support Scanpy and scvi-tools downstream analysis after query-time filtering.
Expose spatial and source-dataset discovery helpers.
requirements: No authentication is required for public Census data.
Use a pinned Census version for reproducibility and enough memory for queried slices.
